title: One More Summer
about: A closing reflection on returning to State Arts-In for one final summer as an Assistant Director without realizing at the time that it would be the last.
description: After a year away, I returned to State Arts-In in 2023 and fell almost immediately back into the familiar rhythm of being an Assistant Director. Lauren and Jenna were beside me, the days started early, the nights ran late, and there was always another project that needed attention. At the time, it felt like another summer rather than an ending. Only later did it become clear that this had been my final year as an AD. I didn't leave because the joy disappeared or because I stopped caring about the people and the program. Life outside SAI was moving forward, and eventually continuing no longer made practical sense. This song is less about why I left and more about appreciating the unusual gift of getting one more summer in a place I still loved before that chapter quietly came to an end.
lyrics: Verse 1
A year away came and went,
Then I walked back through those doors.
Everything felt familiar,
Like I'd never left before.
Another fair, another chance,
Another season on the run.
There was work to do from dawn to dusk,
Before the week had even begun.
Pre-Chorus
Some summers last forever,
Some only last one more year.
You never know you're closing chapters
Until the ending's finally here.
Chorus
One more summer, one more song,
One more place where I belonged.
One more sunrise, one more show,
One more week before I'd go.
I didn't know while living it
This would be the final run.
Sometimes the last page looks exactly
Like the first one.
Verse 2
Lauren, Jenna, there beside me,
Doing what we'd always do.
Long days turned into longer nights,
Helping every project through.
You don't think about tomorrow
When today still needs your hand.
You just keep showing up each morning,
Doing everything you can.
Pre-Chorus
Some summers last forever,
Some only last one more year.
You never know you're closing chapters
Until the ending's finally here.
Chorus
One more summer, one more song,
One more place where I belonged.
One more sunrise, one more show,
One more week before I'd go.
I didn't know while living it
This would be the final run.
Sometimes the last page looks exactly
Like the first one.
Verse 3
It wasn't that the joy had faded,
Or the people changed somehow.
The laughter still was waiting there,
Just like it always had until now.
Life outside kept moving forward,
Dreams don't pause while seasons fly.
Eventually the hardest choices
Don't come from the heart, they come from why.
Bridge
Every memory found its place,
Every lesson found its way.
Some things you carry with you
Long after you walk away.
Not every goodbye needs sadness,
Not every ending needs regret.
Sometimes you're simply thankful
For every moment that you get.
Final Chorus
One more summer, one last year,
One more group I'd always cheer.
One more chance to give my best,
Then leave the story to the rest.
I'll always hear those early mornings,
Feel those late-night hours we've won.
My final year wasn't the end...
It was one more summer done.
Outro
I came back after stepping away.
I left while I still loved it.
And somehow...
that made it the perfect last summer.
